obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The frame is re-derived from the live observation on every action; nothing is stored between pages, and a clause already satisfied by construction costs no action.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: One coordinate change -- (container, identifier, path_from_id) -- serves every record-shaped page, because 'the star of that row' is not an email fact. No app is named anywhere in the module.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Nearest-ancestor-holding-any-control was measured wrong (it stops at div.email-left while the star is in the sibling div.email-right); full_text identity was measured wrong (every ancestor then shows the name); class-prefix control matching was measured wrong (email-sender starts with 'email'); compiling the value once at time zero was measured wrong (the field does not exist yet).

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: None. Every observation in the fixture was captured from the real pages by this project's own chromium bridge at seed 1060, and the 130-page measurement is the real benchmark pages.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: Nine page families that the refusal census could not see are now carried out from the instruction alone: five drag pages graded only on an unstated Submit, four choose-date pages whose date is a coordinate inside a calendar, three click-tab-2 pages whose target sat in a tab the reveal had no name for, and both click-collapsible-2 pages whose exclusive accordion had to be walked rather than re-shut.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Carrying out a sentence whose acts are not all in the sentence: the page decides when work is delivered, and a widget's state must be read and stepped before its parts can be answered -- while refusing, by name, when the page shows a part twice or the sentence is genuinely ambiguous.

recursive_obs.self_model_claim: It can name what it can name, and it says so when it cannot. No further claim is made.
recursive_obs.stop_condition: The two failures the stopping-state census named are closed on the real pages -- an ending the sentence never names, and a date the sentence names as a coordinate -- with zero regressions at three seeds; the 17 new tests pass and the 97 that came before still pass; and the receipt claims no capability, family, terminal or weight credit.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: Every cheaper route was tried against a real page and refused by measurement: adding 'submit' to the compiler's verb list does not help a sentence that never says it; pressing the date FIELD is the wrong half (it opens the calendar); answering '10' on December's grid is a confident wrong answer scored -1; assuming month-first for 11/10 is a locale the reader would have invented; pressing a tab retired the FIND clause because a step is not a target; holding [3,5,7] as container indices failed when opening a section renumbered the page.

v22_prewrite_admission.proof_state_reachability: Naming a region of an observation makes 'act on this one, inside that' reachable for the first time; it discharges no truth obligation.

tournament.decisive_question: Can the machine name the region of one observation that a word picks out, and does naming it convert pages that refusal had called missing state?
tournament.no_known_counterexample_reason: The 130 real pages are the counterexample set: the measurement is itself the falsifier (6 pages gain, 0 regress, and daily-calendar still refuses), so no new external receipt is added by this PR.

verification.result: 12 frame/census tests, 13 descriptor tests, 22 contract tests and 20 policy tests pass; 52 of 130 real pages solved with 0 regressions; model recompiled and verified.
